# MSI Mystic Light SDK payload

For local packaging tests, place `MysticLight_SDK_x64.dll` from MSI's official Mystic Light SDK package in this folder. The Windows build copies it beside `JTG-RGB.exe` when the file is present.

Do not commit or redistribute the native DLL in public builds until MSI's SDK license or written permission confirms redistribution is allowed. The fact that another application uses the SDK does not by itself establish redistribution rights.

MSI Center must still be installed with the Mystic Light feature enabled and running for the integration to work.
